fields.label: Public Name
fields.description: What clients see and send instead of the fieldname, e.g. assistant_name. Letters, digits and _. Empty: the fieldname.

fields.label: Example
fields.description: Value shown in the API docs as an example of what the field holds or a filter expects. Empty: the field's Placeholder (DocType or Customize Form), else one based on the field type.

fields.label: Show Description
fields.description: Show the field's description in the API docs. Fields without a row always show it.

fields.label: Returned In
fields.options:
Lists and Records
Records Only
Never
fields.description: Where reads return the field; request bodies accept it in every case. Records Only: left out of lists (e.g. a long set of numbers), returned when one record is read. Never: write-only, never returned, filtered nor sorted.

fields.label: Lookup
fields.description: Show the field as the matching record of another DocType, e.g. Jambonz Call Stats > agent as the AI Assistant whose agent_id holds it, or AI Assistant > phone_number as the title of its Go4 Phone Number. Clients read, filter and write the other record's value and never see this field's own. Records outside the client's Extra Params are never matched.

fields.label: Lookup Match Field
fields.description: Field of the Lookup DocType holding this field's value, e.g. agent_id.

fields.label: Lookup Value Field
fields.description: Field of the Lookup DocType clients see instead, e.g. name (the record's ID).

fields.label: Restrict Rows
fields.description: When the client has Extra Params on the Lookup DocType, only return rows whose value belongs to one of its records (e.g. calls of its own assistants). Untick when the field only decorates the row (e.g. a phone number title): rows without a matching record would disappear.
